purpose: Questions that future sources should answer automatically when possible before asking the user.

questions.question: Which portions of the 2018 driver hiring/orientation/training workflow remain current, and what newer forms or systems supersede its paper workflow?
Is the March 2023 employee handbook the current handbook? If not, locate the superseding version and effective date.
What exact date and organizational change led from the early-2026 HR & EEO Manager assignment to the EEO Manager/Officer named in the 2026-08-26 signed statement?
Are the 2023 Group A-D disciplinary guidelines still current, and what present-day HR review/approval steps govern discipline?
Document the complete current workplace injury/workers' compensation/OSHA workflow, deadlines, forms, owners and record-separation rules.
Document the complete current vehicle-accident workflow, including notification, internal forms, police/insurance reporting, preventability review, training, discipline and closure.
Document current retirement-plan enrollment/change workflow, provider, payroll implementation, deadlines and retention.
Determine whether the Jobshop Employee Time Record is still active, its pay-period cadence, formulas, approval order and downstream payroll process.
Identify the process/script and approved wording behind the 2026 Rejection Emails workbook and the human-review/send steps.
Determine whether the April 2026 Medicare draft became an approved employee communication or workflow and locate the final version if one exists.
Verify whether the undated pre-employment driver test is still used, whether retesting is allowed, and whether all keyed answers remain current.
Verify whether the 2013/2017 National RTAP customer-service packet remains part of current driver training and how completion is recorded.
What AAP/EEO plan superseded the June 30, 2022 snapshot, and what were the exact effective/submission dates for this plan and its successor?
Are the 2010 Census labor-market source, recruitment areas, internal/external placement weights, and job-group methodology still used in later RTEC AAP plans?

Were the minority/veteran percentage fields in the 2022 AAP workbooks intended to be decimal fractions formatted incorrectly or manually entered values approximately 100x too small? Recover and validate the original formulas/number formats before reusing them.
What current Title VII/EEO and sexual-harassment complaint forms/processes supersede the 2016 Title VII and 2017 sexual-harassment forms found in the 2022 AAP package?
Locate the sample ads/brochures and Commonwealth of Kentucky certification documents referenced by the 2022 AAP binder index but not included in this upload.
Which uploaded job-description version is the current approved version for each active RTEC role, and what effective/revision dates supersede the historical variants?

Resolve conflicting FLSA classifications and role-title variants in the historical job-description archive, notably Human Resources Manager and Information Systems Technician, against current payroll/organizational authority before operational use.

Reconcile qualification, safety-sensitive, background-check, drug/alcohol-testing, physical-demand, pay, benefit, and licensing language in historical job descriptions/recruitment materials with current approved policies and postings before reusing it.

Map every recurring FY2017 Section 5310/5311/5339 assurance/certification page to a single canonical source in the compliance archive and establish version/effective-date history instead of storing binder duplicates.

Build the supersession chain from the September 2016 Title VI/LEP plan through the December 2019 versions to the 2026 Title VI/LEP plan, and identify which complaint/public-notice/language-assistance rules are current.

Validate the current ADA complaint filing deadline, investigation timeline, appeal window, coordinator and form against newer compliance sources before using the historical ADA complaint process operationally.

Document the current RTEC process for assembling annual KYTC/FTA grant applications, including owner by section, source repository, review/signature workflow, deadline tracking and post-award retention.
Identify which FY2017 grant attachments are unique grant evidence versus duplicates of canonical compliance plans, policies, certifications, notices or forms in !Compliance.zip.
